info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Discounts Retrieval API enables businesses to efficiently retrieve discount information associated with retail orders. This endpoint is particularly useful for retailers looking to manage promotions and discounts effectively. Developers can leverage this API to fetch details about available discounts for specific orders, enhancing the customer experience and facilitating informed purchasing decisions. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require seamless integration of discount data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current discounts applicable to orders. Utilize this information to provide clients with the best available offers and optimize their purchasing decisions.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the available discount information.
